projects.name: Project Summary: Local Regulatory Reporting (Asia Pacific & UK)
projects.role: Senior Business Analyst Domain	: Wealth & Investment Banking Client	: Barclays Bank
details: The purpose of the project is the delivery of finance and risk regulatory reports, transaction reports to the local country specific regulators in Asia Pacific region. It also includes risk engine calculations for reporting related to Counterparty Credit risk, Market risk, Liquidity risk, Basel III implementation, IFRS 9 implementation, and exposure to methodologies like VaR, Expected shortfall, PE, EEPE, CVA, etc.
Roles and Responsibilities:
Understanding the new finance and risk regulatory requirements from the business and performing the impact analysis to the current architecture.

Requirements gathering and understanding the changes applicable to the various businesses for products like Equity, Fixed Income, FX, AML, Rates, Commodities, Structured credit products, Derivatives, loans & deposits, collateral management, profit & loss, etc.
Ensuring the regulatory transaction reporting regulations (CFTC, EMIR) are adhered to accurately.
Assisting the agile team in database design and micro services workflow to perform individual functions.
Knowledge Transfer session to the subsequent Development and Test teams.
Writing down the BRDs and FRDs as and when required, constructing process flow diagrams, use case diagrams, architecture diagram at articulate scope/requirements.

projects.name: Project Summary: STP – Fulfilment & Multi-Channel Application
projects.role: Module Lead Domain	: Retail Banking Client	: HTSE, UK
details: The purpose of the project is to create a service which would integrate with different downstream systems via a middleware layer for client/account creation and maintenance. Multi-Channel Application (MCA) is a multi-purpose application which includes a single functionality for multiple channels like telephony, staff-facing, and customer-facing for Account Opening and Account maintenance purposes in Barclays.
Roles and Responsibilities:
Functional analysis and studying the business requirements of the project & document business requirements, process & data flows.
Modeling of current state/new state data & process models.
Supporting of application processes implementations.
Identify and manage business and data requirements change and implications across the lifecycle.
Manage traceability of requirements.
Additionally, contribute to functional impact analysis in the event of changes to business objectives, requirements and/or technical data/architectures/platforms.

projects.name: Project Summary: BMM, CNS and STP
details: Browser Main Menu (BMM) is a staff facing application which is used in the bank and call centre to provide account maintenance and support to UK customers. Customer Needs System (CNS) is an application which is used by the bank staff for Account Opening. Straight through Processing (STP) is an internet-based application which is used for account opening and maintenance.
Roles and Responsibilities:
Involved in test case preparation, data setup, peer review, test case execution, and defect retesting and client co-ordination.
Preparing the project estimates and verifying the same sent by the client.
Create a Test Activity Plan (TAP) and test design for the system test phase of the project.
Looking closely at Deliverables, Risks, Mitigations, Challenges and Value additions for projects.
Provide UAT support and create a Test Activity Completion Certificate.
Attend PIR meeting/process and provide comments on successes/improvements to process.
